reviewer: Primary agent self-review, without subagents at the owner's request
scope: Complete implementation diff, filesystem and stage tests, worker/CLI integration, native diagnostics and storage, replay changes, device reports and documentation
reviewed: Every cache hit first re-admits canonical input and its transitive source fingerprints. Exact mappings, input bits, DSP recipe, output policy and engine pin participate in BLAKE3 identity.
A complete payload checksum, finite samples and exact header/extent are required before private PCM is published. Failed copies drop without replacing canonical output.

Publication reserves the entire logical size under a nonblocking cache lock, writes and syncs staging, then atomically renames. Cleanup and replacement skip active file locks; pathname operations stay descriptor-relative.

Cache scans share a separate 16,777,216-unit allowance across nested calls. They do not spend the canonical plan-query allowance. Source checks, stage/frame counts, memory, disk and the original deadline remain shared.
Optional cache I/O failures rebuild or retain canonical private PCM. Source admission, cancellation and deadlines remain errors. The audio callback and authored store are unchanged.
Storage reports bounded entries without claiming to verify payloads during listing. Native status reports the request's last saved/restored stage and reason; no report is readiness authority.
Cold cache creation adds measured work. Fresh-process restoration is verified, but the single-run measurements are not latency distributions or physical listening evidence.
fixes: Temporary lock contention no longer disables the cache for an entire retained session.
Idle preparation also exposes cache status; long Storage keys wrap in the value column.
Corruption tests flip a bit instead of risking replacement with the original byte.

The four-minute device fixture exposed exhaustion of the canonical query budget by optional lookup. A separate bounded allowance and explicit direct-preparation fallback fix it. Both pre-fix failure reports are retained.
verification_notes: Initial compiler iterations and the accidentally selected empty app library tests are retained. Corrected app executable-target tests ran the actual native cases.
Final full suites pass 516 audio and 88 playback tests. They include 13 cache regressions. Storage, diagnostics, transport, strict Clippy, formatting and offscreen replays pass.

Inspected visual-replays/diagnostics/diagnostics-014.png and visual-replays/storage/storage-015.png. New status text, the entire wrapped key, validity text and fixed controls are visible. Paint assertions include clips and later opaque occluders.
Six final release device runs restore the same keys across process restart or prepare with caching disabled. They report no audio failures or missed pictures in the observed intervals.
The pre-fix performance processes exit successfully while their JSON failure field records frozen projection work exhausted. The evidence checker checks the semantic field, not just exit status.
Executed binaries are pinned by SHA-256. The failed pre-fix executable was not rebuilt as an archived historical checkout. Final changed source and base revision are retained.
remaining: Hold-specific reverse/room-tone caches remain private. Complete voice/group processing, mastering, broader device/export qualification and the full product requirements remain open. This increment does not complete DP-09 or DP-16.
